attchmntText: Nitiraj Engineers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nitiraj Engineers Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results include a Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors Sharp Aarth & Co LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 185.04 lakh rupees, compared to 130.38 lakh rupees for the same period in 2025. Revenue from operations stood at 2,889.48 lakh rupees for the half year. The trading window will open 48 hours after the declaration of these financial results. The meeting commenced at 2:40 PM and concluded at 3:10 PM.
